usage: git status [<options>] [--] [<pathspec>...]

    -v, --[no-]verbose    be more talkative
    -s, --[no-]short      terse output
    -b, --[no-]branch     show the branch
    --[no-]porcelain[=<version>]
                          machine output
    -u, --[no-]untracked-files[=<mode>]
                          untracked mode
